agy-NOV

The 100% Native Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0.

One plugin. Thirteen toggleable superpowers built on a clean 4-layer zero-cycle systems architecture (verified via TypeScript AST & Layer 2 horizontal cross-module allowlist) with full macOS / Windows / Linux native cross-platform compatibility (3-OS × Node 20/22 CI + 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing), featuring immediate dual-star feed-snapshot.json refresh & accurate aggregation (PreToolUse deny/force_ask/ask & CLI mutators, createdAt-ordered latestSnapshotId, real-deny GUARD_BLOCKED, latest-timestamp verify summary), disabled-module hard gating & PostToolUse O(1) short-circuit (cfg.modules.mem gate in archiveSpecToMemory & cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard} Sidecar gating), an opt-in read-only scheduled audit Sidecar (sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs, OFF by default) & 11th CLI command audit-once (+0 model tools), Layer 1 shared loopback-only ConversationService Connect API collaboration (powering confirmation-gated Clean Fork app_xray_fork_via_service & read-only Radar reconciliation app_radar_reconcile_conversations, +0 model tools), Antigravity Marketplace readiness alignment (10-key plugin.json with concise 148-char description + 18-asset & 4-check Marketplace doctor), Spec DAG → /run-workflow Python & /swarm plan.json native orchestration compilation (+0 model tools), PreInvocation local inbound secret hard gating (terminationBehavior: "terminate"), official 6th Lifecycle Hook PostInvocation zero-token turn receipts, 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}), Antigravity 2.35 CLI statusLine stdin JSON fusion (11 composable segments incl. model & quota), Antigravity CLI 100-tool budget gating (auto-hiding app_* tools when MCP UI extensions are absent so full stays strictly at 47 tools), live roots/list dynamic workspace tracking, cross-platform plugin-root relative hooks (node dist/hook.cjs --event <Event>), 4+1 domain IA & 4-tier Settings Hub (with S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0, One-Click Clean Fork, 6 official on-demand Skills (slimmed 9.5 KB entry Skill) & 2 read-only specialist subagents, native MCP Apps file viewer, Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, 6 official Hooks, 8-language full-component UI (755 core keys × 8 locales + full Spec export localization, 1,390.2 KB), minified backend bundles & 11-command CLI (18-asset doctor). Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, strictly 47 canonical model tools with zero token tax when off.

> [!NOTE] > **Independent Open-Source Project:** `agy-NOV` (v1.2.1) is an independent, MIT-licensed community plugin built for Google Antigravity 2.0 across **macOS, Windows, and Linux**. It has no affiliation with, sponsorship from, or endorsement by Google LLC. --- ## 30-Second Read-Only First Try Evaluate `agy-NOV` on your current workspace with **zero file edits, zero config writes, and zero network traffic**: ```bash # 1. Scan your repo read-only and preview a safe .agy-nov.json team preset scaffold (zero disk writes) # After `agy plugin install` (zero global install needed): node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/dist/cli.cjs recommend --workspace=. --export-preset # Or if you linked `agy-nov` globally (`npm link` inside the plugin directory) or inside a cloned repo: agy-nov recommend --export-preset ``` 2. Paste this **100% read-only first prompt** into Antigravity 2.0 once installed (also available inside the **L0 Workflow Hub** and the collapsible **30-Second Zero-Risk First Try** guide in **Settings Hub**): > *"Open agy-NOV Context X-Ray in read-only mode to inspect my estimated offline USD spend, 5-hour burn-rate window, and prefix cache hit rate — then open Two-Stage Diff Review with `-w` whitespace-ignored and line risk hints without modifying any files."* --- ## Why agy-NOV? Installing separate MCP servers and hook scripts for code review, secret scanning, Spec-driven plan reviews & workflow compilation, Stop-hook verification, Git worktrees, local data/document/OpenAPI debugging, Swarm & offline USD telemetry, confidence-governed progressive memory, token-saving log compression, session tracking, and static security/dedup/budget audits quickly turns a clean Antigravity workspace into a noisy stack of background daemons pushing against Antigravity's **100-tool MCP hard limit**. | Dimension | ❌ Plugin Sprawl (12–13 Separate Tools) | ✅ agy-NOV Super-Workbench | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Resident Processes** | 12–13 background Node/Python servers competing for RAM and startup time | **1 resident MCP server** (`dist/server.cjs`, minified `1,584.5 KB` / `~1.55 MiB`) serving all enabled capabilities with live `roots/list` workspace tracking, **4 zero-injection-tax `agy-nov://context/*` resources**, & **1 opt-in OFF-by-default module-gated read-only Audit Sidecar** (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, zero idle daemon) | | **Per-Turn Token & Tool Cap** | 70+ static tool schemas plus bulky resident `rules/AGENTS.md` files crowding the 100-tool limit | **Dynamic `tools/list`** (strictly **47** canonical model tools max across `v0.4`→`v1.2.1`, `0` token & tool-slot tax when off) + **CLI 47-tool ceiling gate** (auto-hiding `app_*`/`nov_app_*` on headless CLI clients without MCP UI extensions) + **SettingsHub S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor** + **6 on-demand Skills (slimmed `9.5 KB` entry Skill) & 2 read-only subagents** with zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat | | **Lifecycle Hook Storm** | Multiple forked hook scripts racing on every `SessionStart` / `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` / `PreInvocation` / `PostInvocation` / `Stop` | **1 unified 6-hook dispatcher** (`dist/hook.cjs`, minified `212.8 KB`) invoked via cross-platform plugin-root relative `node dist/hook.cjs --event `, with O(1) read-only short-circuiting (including all-disabled `PostToolUse`), immediate `PreToolUse` `feed-snapshot.json` refresh before `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask`, `PreInvocation` local inbound secret hard gating (`terminationBehavior: "terminate"`), `PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipts, official `Stop` `decision: "continue"`, and explicit `PreToolUse` `{ decision: "allow" }` | | **Upgrade Durability & OS Support** | Binary `app.asar` patches, POSIX-only shell assumptions, and DOM hooks break after updates or on Windows/Linux | **100% official native protocols** — Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, clean **4-layer zero-cycle architecture** ([`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), enforced via TypeScript AST & Layer 2 cross-module allowlist) with shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API, official MCP Apps `file` viewer (with `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read`), Marketplace-ready 10-key manifest, and full **macOS / Windows / Linux** native compatibility (3-OS × Node 20/22 CI + 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing) | | **Workflow, Governance & UX** | Disconnected panels, stale/unverified memories, unvetted rules/hooks, cramped sidebars, English-only screens | **Opt-In Module-Gated Read-Only Audit Sidecar (`audit-once`)**, **Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` Compiler**, **11-segment stdin-fused CLI `statusLine`**, **Ops 3.0** static security & dedup preview, **Mem 3.0** confidence/TTL hygiene, **One-Click Clean Fork** (+ `ConversationService` create), **Radar live host reconciliation**, **4+1 Domain IA** (`Hub` + 4 domains, adaptive `< 720px` / `>= 720px` nav with `global` degradation, `⌘K`), **4-tier Settings Hub**, **8-language full-component UI (24 components)**, **5 presets**, `.agy-nov.json` team presets, and **11 CLI commands** | ### The 100% Native Switchboard Philosophy 1. **Single Native Runtime + 4-Layer Architecture + Opt-In Sidecar & Zero-Bloat Playbooks:** 1 MCP server (`dist/server.cjs`, `1,584.5 KB` / `~1.55 MiB`, exposing **4 zero-injection-tax `agy-nov://context/*` read-only resources**) + 1 unified **6-hook** lifecycle dispatcher (`dist/hook.cjs`, `212.8 KB`, covering `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `PostInvocation`, and `Stop` via plugin-root relative `node dist/hook.cjs --event `) + 1 self-contained 8-language dark/light UI (`dist/ui/app.html`, `~1.36 MiB` — measured **`1,390.2 KB`**, far below the 10 MiB resource cap, shipping **755 core dictionary keys × 8 locales** plus full key-symmetric localization for Spec workflow export across all **24 UI components**) + 1 modular **11-command CLI** (`dist/cli.cjs`, `201.2 KB`, including module-gated `audit-once` read-only health sweep, Antigravity 2.35 stdin JSON-fused 11-segment `statusline`, read-only `compile-spec`, preview-then-confirm `recommend --export-preset`, zero-split-brain `resolveNovDataDir()`, immediate `feed-snapshot.json` sync on config mutators, and Marketplace-ready `doctor` verifying all **18** core plugin assets + **4** Marketplace Readiness Checks) + 1 opt-in OFF-by-default read-only Audit Sidecar ([`sidecars/README.md`](./sidecars/README.md)) + **6 official on-demand Skills** (`skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` slimmed to **`9.5 KB`** + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`, `/nov-workflow`) + **2 official read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, `agents/nov-security-auditor.md`), keeping zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat across **macOS, Windows, and Linux**. 2. **Zero Token & Tool-Slot Tax When Off (+ CLI 47-Tool Ceiling Gate):** Every module wraps its model tools in `RegisteredTool.enable()` / `.disable()` and pushes delta `tools/list_changed` notifications live. All **47 canonical model tool names** stay strictly unchanged from `v0.4` through `v1.2.1` (+0 tool-slot inflation); all Hub, Settings Hub (incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Spec workflow compilation (`app_spec_compile_workflow`), Context Pack, Turn Rewind, Clean Fork (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` & confirmation-gated `app_xray_fork_via_service`), Radar live host reconciliation (`app_radar_reconcile_conversations`), `.worktreeinclude` preview (`app_worktree_preview_include`), PR evidence summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), Mem 3.0 hygiene summary & batch cleanup (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary`, `app_mem_batch_hygiene`), and native `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`) controls run strictly as App-only tools (`visibility: ['app']`) with zero model-context overhead — and when a headless Antigravity CLI client connects without `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]`, the server hides every `app_*` / `nov_app_*` tool automatically so even `full` exposes strictly 47 tools. 3. **Production-Grade Loop & 12 Local Offline Modules First:** Organized into **L0 Workflow Hub** (6-node pipeline bar + alert cards + One-Click Clean Fork + `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump) and 4 clear domains — **Core Essentials** (`core`: Two-Stage `review`, **Guard 2.5**, `xray` 2.0 + Clean Fork), **Engineering Pipeline** (`pipeline`: **Spec 2.0 + Workflow Compiler**, `worktree` with read-only `.worktreeinclude`, `verify` with Worktree targeting & PR summary, **Turbo 3.0**, **Mem 3.0**), **On-Demand Toolbox** (`toolbox`: `radar` 4-lane Kanban + live host reconciliation, `studio`, `canvas`, **Ops 3.0**), and **Opt-In Connectivity** (`connectivity`: **Remote 2.5**). All 12 Tier-1 modules run 100% locally with zero external network calls, zero ASAR edits, and zero CDP hooks. 4. **Zero-Port Dual-Star Feed & 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (`Remote 2.5`):** Event-driven `/feed-snapshot.json` (`0600` atomic, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted, refreshed immediately before `PreToolUse` `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask` decisions and after CLI `enable`/`disable`/`preset`/`locale` updates, with `createdAt`-ordered `latestSnapshotId`, real-deny `GUARD_BLOCKED` reasons, latest-timestamp `verify` summary unified with `remote/hook.ts`, plus `forceAskCount`, `permissionMode`, and `snapshotCount`, zero mkdir/writes when `dataDir` is absent) enables zero-port read-only telemetry sharing with `agy-Sag`, while `remote` stays completely OFF by default — zero listening ports, zero background polling, zero disk writes, and zero outbound network requests until you explicitly enable it. --- ## What's New in v1.2.1 `v1.2.1` hardens **dual-star snapshot consistency & accuracy**, enforces **disabled-module hard gating & `PostToolUse` O(1) short-circuiting**, upgrades **architecture gatekeeping to TypeScript AST parsing**, and slims the entry Skill `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` down to **`9.5 KB`** — preserving **+0 model tool bloat** (all **47** canonical model tools strictly unchanged from `v0.4`→`v1.2.1`, verified by **101 suites / 286 tests** across the 3-OS CI matrix; measured minified bundles: `dist/server.cjs` **`1,584.5 KB`** / `~1.55 MiB`, `dist/hook.cjs` **`212.8 KB`**, `dist/cli.cjs` **`201.2 KB`**, `dist/ui/app.html` **`1,390.2 KB`** / `~1.36 MiB`, `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` **`9.5 KB`**): ### 1. Immediate Dual-Star Snapshot Refresh & Accurate Aggregation (`hooks`, `cli`, `core`, `remote`) - **Immediate `PreToolUse` & CLI Snapshot Sync:** `PreToolUse` refreshes `/feed-snapshot.json` immediately before `guard`, `spec`, or `remote` returns `deny`, `force_ask`, or `ask`, and CLI mutators (`enable`, `disable`, `preset`, `locale`) synchronously refresh an existing `feed-snapshot.json` right after writing `config.json` (preserving zero-mkdir/zero-write isolation whenever `dataDir` is absent). - **Accurate Snapshot, Alert & Verify Telemetry:** Fixed `latestSnapshotId` resolution in `src/core/feed.ts` by sorting snapshots by `createdAt` to pick the newest entry, bound `GUARD_BLOCKED` alert reasons strictly to genuine `deny` / `blocked` events, and unified `verify` summary selection across `src/core/feed.ts` and `src/modules/remote/hook.ts` to consistently select the latest timestamp. ### 2. Disabled-Module Hard Gating & `PostToolUse` O(1) Short-Circuit (`spec`, `mem`, `server`, `hooks`) - **Live `spec -> mem` Archival Hard Gate:** `archiveSpecToMemory` checks live `cfg.modules.mem` before persisting — when `mem` is turned off, archival refuses writes cleanly with zero directory creation. - **Module-Gated Audit Sidecar & `PostToolUse` O(1) Short-Circuit:** Read-only Audit Sidecar sweeps (`src/server/sidecar.ts`) gate Mem, Verify, and Guard checks on `cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard}` to eliminate false positives from historical files left by disabled modules, and `PostToolUse` short-circuits in O(1) when all participating modules are off. ### 3. TypeScript AST Architecture Guard & Slimmed `9.5 KB` Entry Skill (`test`, `skills/`, `docs/`) - **AST-Level Layer Governance:** Upgraded `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts` to TypeScript AST import parsing with an explicit Layer 2 horizontal cross-module import allowlist, accompanied by `test/v121-consistency-hardening.test.ts` raising automated verification to **101 suites / 286 tests**. - **Slimmed Entry Skill & Synchronized Contracts:** Condensed `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` from ~30 KB down to **`9.5 KB`** (clearing `ops.large-instruction-file` warnings) and updated [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [`docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md`](./docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md) to `v1.2.1`.
Built on the v1.2.0 Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar, Layer 1 Shared ConversationService & Marketplace Readiness Foundation - **Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar & 11th CLI Command `audit-once` (`v1.2.0`):** Zero-daemon read-only health sweep (`src/server/sidecar.ts`, `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, [`sidecars/README.md`](./sidecars/README.md)) staying completely OFF by default until invoked manually, via Antigravity `/schedule`, or via OS schedulers (`cron`, `launchd`, Windows Task Scheduler); aggregates redacted Ops/Mem/Verify/Guard telemetry with guarded `--write-report` atomic `<= 64 KiB` `0600` `health-sweep.json` persistence strictly inside an existing safe non-symlink `dataDir`. - **Layer 1 Shared Loopback-Only `ConversationService` Connect API Collaboration (`v1.2.0`):** Shared anti-SSRF loopback client (`src/core/conversation-service.ts`, `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]` only, silent degradation, zero CSRF echo, full outbound redaction) powering confirmation-gated `app_xray_fork_via_service` (dry-run + `confirmCreate`, `app.sendMessage` fallback) and zero-write `app_radar_reconcile_conversations` (surfacing idle ghost & newly active host sessions) with +0 model tools. - **Antigravity Marketplace Readiness Certification & 18-Asset `doctor` (`v1.2.0`):** Strictly 10 official top-level keys in `plugin.json` (148-char `description`, 3 validated `suggestedPrompts`, 128×128 transparent-background `assets/logo.svg`) backed by 18-asset & 4-check Marketplace Readiness verification in `agy-nov doctor`.
Built on the v1.1.0 4-Layer Architecture Refactor, Spec DAG Workflow Compiler, Deterministic Security 2.0 & Antigravity 2.35 CLI statusLine Foundation - **4-Layer Modular Systems Architecture Refactor (`v1.1.0`):** Extracted zero-module-import Layer 1 core kernel (`src/core/{fs-safe,process-safe,brain-paths,sanitize,module-contract}.ts`), decomposed 8 oversized monoliths (`ops/core.ts`, `verify/core.ts`, `studio/core.ts`, `turbo/core.ts`, `spec/core.ts`, `worktree/core.ts`, `cli.ts`, `SpecPanel.tsx`) with zero circular dependencies, published [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md), and enforced layer rules via `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`. - **Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` Native Orchestration Compiler (`v1.1.0`):** Kahn topological wave compiler (`src/modules/spec/compiler.ts`) generating `/run-workflow` Python orchestration (`phase`/`parallel`/`agent`/`log` chaining `nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`, and `Verify Gate`) and `/swarm` `plan.json` blueprints with cycle blocking, linear redaction, App-only `app_spec_compile_workflow` 8-language UI modal, read-only CLI `compile-spec`, and 6th official Skill `/nov-workflow`. - **Deterministic Security & Zero-Injection Context 2.0 (`v1.1.0`):** `PreInvocation` local inbound high-confidence secret hard gate (`terminationBehavior: "terminate"`, zero secret echo, Guard `blockInboundPromptSecrets`), official 6th Lifecycle Hook `PostInvocation` (O(1) short-circuit, zero-token `systemMessage: ""` + `metadata.user_markdown` turn receipts), and 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (`agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}`, `<= 32 KiB`, linear redacted, zero writes). - **Antigravity 2.35 CLI `statusLine` stdin JSON Fusion (`v1.1.0`):** Async bounded host stdin JSON telemetry reader (`model`, `context_window`, `cost`, `quota`, `subagents`, `workspace`, zero-delay TTY bypass, `120ms` timeout, `256 KiB` cap) expanding composable segments to **11** (adding `model` and `quota`).
Built on the v1.0.0–v1.0.2 Runtime Hardening, Cross-Platform & Governance Foundation (CLI 47-Tool Gate, roots/list Sync, 3-OS Support, Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0 & .agy-nov.json Scaffold) - **Real-Host Runtime Hardening & Full 8-Language Parity (`v1.0.2`):** Official `Stop` `decision: "continue"` (`terminationReason` safe pass-through) & `PreToolUse` `{ decision: "allow" }`; cross-platform plugin-root relative `hooks.json` (`node dist/hook.cjs --event `) + 3-OS black-box hook tests; Antigravity CLI 47-tool ceiling gate auto-hiding `app_*` tools when `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]` is absent; live `roots/list` dynamic workspace sync & split-brain-free `resolveNovDataDir()`; `NovBridge` first-frame `ontoolresult` replay, real `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read`, and `global` capability degradation; 755 core dictionary keys × 8 locales across all 24 UI components; minified backend bundles; enriched `feed-snapshot.json` telemetry; Remote 2.5 same-origin PIN lockout DoS guard & bounded SSE heartbeats; Mem 3.0 batch `verify` anchor refresh; Auto-RTK non-ASCII/parenthesis path support; native `read_file` subagent alignment. - **Full macOS / Windows / Linux Cross-Platform Support (`v1.0.1`):** `canonicalRealpathSync` Windows 8.3 short-path expansion & case-insensitive boundary checks + Linux `/home`/`/var/run`/`/var/lock` system symlink allowlist; `atomicRenameSync` NTFS retry; Windows `shell: false` Node JS entry resolution for `npm`/`npx`/`pnpm`/`yarn`/`tsc`/`eslint`/`vitest`/`jest` (CVE-2024-27980-safe); PowerShell/`cmd` destructive rules in `guard`/`remote`; `taskkill /T /F` in `verify`; headless-Linux notification skipping in `radar`; 3-OS × Node 20/22 GitHub Actions CI matrix. - **Ops 3.0 Static Security Audit, Cross-Client Dedup Preview & Tool-Slot Idle Advisor (`v1.0.0`):** Pure read-only O(n) `ops_audit_workspace` scanner (`securityFindings` + `securityScore` 0–100 across `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, `mcp-unsafe-env` with zero secret echoing and zero false positives on compliant repos), read-only `.claude/`/`.cursor/rules/`/`.codex/` SHA-256 `migrationPreview`, and SettingsHub S4 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**. - **Mem 3.0 Confidence/TTL Hygiene & Preview-Then-Confirm `.agy-nov.json` Scaffold (`v1.0.0`):** Confidence tiers (`verified`/`normal`/`tentative`), provenance (`manual`/`spec_archive`/`auto_capture`), `ttlDays` (1–365), `Stop`-hook `tentative` + 14-day TTL auto-capture, auto-filtering expired tentative memories in `SessionStart` L1 & default `mem_recall`, `MemPanel` batch Verify / Refresh TTL (+30d) / Prune (double confirm), and read-only default `recommend --export-preset` writing atomically only with explicit `--confirm` (`--force` for overwrites, symlink refusal, zero `remote`, allowlisted verify commands).
Built on the Complete v0.7–v0.9 Native Foundation (Pipeline Loop, Clean Fork, On-Demand Playbooks & Subagents, Native file Viewer, Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5 & Spec 2.0) - **End-to-End Engineering Pipeline Loop (`Spec → Worktree → Two-Stage Review → Verify → Mem` + Radar Kanban):** Safe read-only `.worktreeinclude` allowlist (`app_worktree_preview_include` + `applyInclude`, rejecting `.env*`/private keys/symlinks into `skippedSensitive` with zero auto-RCE scripts), Worktree branch switching + Two-Stage Review (Stage 1 active Spec compliance checklist + Stage 2 code quality `file:line` annotations), Worktree-targeted Verify (`worktreePath`) + redacted PR delivery summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), and approval-first 4-lane Radar Kanban. - ## Highlights

### Dual-Star `feed-snapshot.json` Real-Time Consistency
- **Immediate `PreToolUse` Refresh**: Guard, Spec, and Remote now refresh `feed-snapshot.json` immediately before returning `deny`, `force_ask`, or `ask` (strictly zero-write / zero-mkdir when `dataDir` is absent or symlinked).
- **CLI Mutation Sync**: `agy-nov enable`, `disable`, `preset`, and `locale` now refresh an existing non-symlink `feed-snapshot.json` immediately after persisting `config.json`.
- **Accurate Guard & Verify Summaries**: `latestSnapshotId` now selects the newest snapshot via `createdAt ?? timestamp` (with whitespace/empty-string fallback); `GUARD_BLOCKED` alerts always cite the latest `deny`/`blocked` reason; Verify evidence ordering is aligned across `feed.ts`, `remote/hook.ts`, and `sidecar.ts`.

### Disabled-Module Hard Gates & O(1) Short-Circuits
- **`spec -> mem` Live Gate**: `archiveSpecToMemory` verifies `cfg.modules.mem` at runtime and refuses disk writes (zero directory creation) when `mem` is disabled.
- **Sidecar Module Gating**: `runReadOnlyHealthSweep` (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` / `agy-nov audit-once`) gates `mem`, `verify`, and `guard` reads by active config toggles to prevent stale historical false positives.
- **`PostToolUse` O(1) Short-Circuit**: Added top-level zero-I/O return when all 5 listener modules (`review`, `xray`, `radar`, `verify`, `turbo`) are OFF.

### Architecture Hygiene & Skill Slimming
- **TypeScript AST Boundary Guard**: Upgraded `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts` to full TypeScript AST import scanning (`ScriptKind.TS`/`TSX`, dynamic `import()`, `import()` types, `import =`) with an explicit Layer 2 cross-module allowlist.
- **Entry Skill Slimmed**: Trimmed `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` from ~30 KB to **9.5 KB** while retaining all 47 canonical model tools and 11 CLI commands, clearing `ops.large-instruction-file` warnings.
- **Updated Contracts**: Synced `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md`, and all 8 localized READMEs to `v1.2.1`.

## Verified Metrics
- **Architecture**: 100% Zero ASAR / Zero CDP · 13 native modules · 5 presets · **47 canonical model tools (+0)** · 6 Hooks · 11 CLI commands · 6 Skills · 2 read-only subagents
- **Bundles**: `dist/server.cjs` (1,584.5 KB) · `dist/hook.cjs` (212.8 KB) · `dist/cli.cjs` (201.2 KB) · `dist/ui/app.html` (1,390.2 KB, well under 10 MiB)
- **CI Verification**: **101 suites / 286 tests** passing across macOS / Windows / Linux × Node 20 / 22 ([CI Run 46107875098](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/actions/runs/46107875098))
